title: Account for impairment of indefinite life intangible assets and goodwill

items.concept: Period-end quantitative impairment adjusting entries for an indefinite-life trade name and for goodwill of a reporting unit; initial recognition; carrying-amount schedule; post-impairment disposal
Number-variant twin: initial recognition of brand and residual goodwill; subsequent zero-amortization schedule with Year-3 period-end impairments; disposal of brand after impairment

Period-end adjusting entries under edge cases — FV ≥ CA (no loss); goodwill impairment capped at GW when RU shortfall exceeds GW; qualitative assessment that stops testing; disposal of indefinite-life asset
Quantitative goodwill impairment amount = excess of reporting-unit CA over RU FV, limited to allocated goodwill
Classification of impairment testing model — indefinite-life one-step FV vs CA (optional qualitative first); not the finite-life recoverability test
